repair: Refused (step.pose.fact), at dim.fwd: A `dim.<id>` fact does not hold over a step's whole motion domain at its pose (every input its `spin` plays, at its explode value and placements): one of its `check` claims, or for a posed step its caption, the title or the text of an annotation it shows. `part` names the fact; `dimensionMotion` is added when the motion bound decides it.
note: DELIBERATE NEGATIVE CONTROL: in step 3 the yaw motor does not cancel the drone's yaw; the engine must refuse the level check
